description.label: Description
description.value:
Awarded For: Purging one of the Empire’s large towns or cities by wiping out an entire underground network of its enemies, such as a Chaos Cult, Rebel Cell or a lesser Skaven Clan.

Description: A gold medallion encrusted with red gemstones and emblazoned with a red gem encrusted skull surrounded by flames.

Bonuses: Wearers of this medal regain +1 Wound per hour and the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.xx8SgdWYEjKct7ym]{Implacable} Talent is added to the Talent list of any career you are in.

Automation (Wave 2): Until automated, the GM applies the bonuses above manually when the medal is worn (Imperial Honors) or when the honor applies (Kill Counts).

Medal Notes

Talents granted by medals apply only to the original recipient. Non-talent bonuses require the medal to be worn by the earner. Non-earners do not gain these benefits — the GM enforces recipient rules (no automatic earner lock). Medals can be identified with Easy (+40) Lore (Empire / Heraldry / History). Fake medals: Evaluate + Numismatics (GM difficulty).
